# awscc_lakeformation_resource (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::LakeFormation::Resource



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Data Source.
- `use_service_linked_role` (Boolean) Designates a trusted caller, an IAM principal, by registering this caller with the Data Catalog.

### Optional

- `hybrid_access_enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the data access of tables pointing to the location can be managed by both Lake Formation permissions as well as Amazon S3 bucket policies.
- `role_arn` (String) The IAM role that registered a resource.
- `with_federation` (Boolean) Allows Lake Formation to assume a role to access tables in a federated database.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `resource_id` (String) The CloudFormation primary identifier for the LakeFormation::Resource. Mirrors ResourceArn once the resource exists; populated by the handler. Customers should reference the LakeFormation::Resource by ResourceArn.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lakeformation_resource.example
  identity = {
    id = "id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) The CloudFormation primary identifier for the LakeFormation::Resource

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_lakeformation_resource.example
  id = "id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

